name: ecommerce-returns
description: What came back after delivery, and what the merchant decided about it: a request that is authorised or refused, goods that arrive or never do, an inspection that says what is saleable, and a refund recorded as an amount and a reference rather than taken.
features: Eligibility as an input, never a lookup
Requested, approved and received kept as separate facts
Unauthorised goods refused rather than adopted
Two exception classes for two opposite receipt failures
Refunds as an amount and a reference
Reasons as a closed set of slugs
